title: Shopper Operations Standard: Out-of-Stock Defaults, Price Caps and Weighed Items (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
Shopper operations standard — out-of-stock lines, price caps and weighed items on Cartwise Grocery Orders.

When a line is out of stock and the customer has set no preference for it, the shopper applies the service level's default handling. A question sent to the customer in chat that goes unanswered for the service level's approval wait counts as no answer. The same service level also fixes the substitution price cap and the tolerance for items sold by weight.

| Service level | Default for an out-of-stock line with no preference | Approval wait for a chat answer | Substitution price cap | Weighed-item tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | best match | 10 minutes | 20 percent | 10 percent |
| No-Rush Delivery | best match | 10 minutes | 20 percent | 10 percent |
| Standard Delivery | best match | 5 minutes | 20 percent | 10 percent |
| Priority Delivery | best match | 5 minutes | 20 percent | 10 percent |
| Express 30 Delivery | refund | 3 minutes | 15 percent | 10 percent |
| Stock-Up Delivery | best match | 10 minutes | 25 percent | 10 percent |

**What each column means**

- *Default handling* is one of three settings — best match, contact me, or refund. Five service levels default to best match; Express 30 Delivery defaults to refund. No service level currently defaults to contact me.
- *Approval wait* is the number of minutes the shopper waits for the customer's chat answer before applying the default.
- *Substitution price cap* is the percentage by which the unit price of a replacement the shopper chose without the customer's approval may exceed the original unit price before substitution price protection comes into question.
- *Weighed-item tolerance* is the percentage by which a weighed item's billed weight may exceed the requested weight before the part above the tolerance is refunded.

**Worked readings (hypothetical figures)**

- Original unit price 5.00 USD at Standard Delivery: a 20 percent cap puts the limit at 6.00 USD, so a replacement at 6.00 is not above the cap and one at 6.01 is.
- Original unit price 5.00 USD at Express 30 Delivery: the 15 percent cap puts the limit at 5.75 USD.
- Requested weight 2.0 pounds: a 10 percent tolerance allows up to 2.2 pounds.
